_comment: PE integration config for localAIStack: CareKit and the OpenClaw xACP agent dispatch contract.
Sensor regions match Python constants in services/api/core/reality_bridge.py
and machine input windows in data/machines/. Update all three together.
ACP completion lands at perceptual space [4210:4214] (4-element region).
HealthKit maps no sensors here. The bridge's families land in the corpus lanes
[4320:4344] through the lane mappings in RealityEngine_CI config/integrations.json
(localHealthkitBridge docs/lane-semantics.json). localAIStack grades them and owns

integrations._comment: Receives POST /api/integrations/healthkit/ingest from localHealthkitBridge. Families are pre-normalised lane values; see the header comment for where they land.
Receives POST /api/integrations/carekit/ingest from iOS CareKit sync. Pre-normalised ratio values [0.0, 1.0].
OpenClaw xACP gateway. Gateway URL / session key are overridden by ACP_GATEWAY_URL and ACP_SESSION_KEY env vars at PE startup.

sourceMappings.name: openclaw/acp/completion
sourceMappings._comment: ACP completion slot — [completed, failed, confidence, actionClass]. Template {agent} resolves to the dispatched agent name.

bandThresholds._comment: Must match Python constants in services/api/core/reality_bridge.py.
